featured_reviews.name: sri prakash
featured_reviews.review_text: My custom name-imprinted coffee cups arrived today and they look amazing! The personalization makes them even more beautiful. Thank you so much for the great work. I’ll definitely be ordering more in the future and recommending you to all my friends and family!

featured_reviews.name: Hilda James
featured_reviews.review_text: Ordered 3 customized Christmas hangings with baby names and one for our pet, and they turned out absolutely beautiful. The quality and personalization were perfect. It made my Christmas so special. Highly recommend !!

featured_reviews.name: Tushna Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm absolutely pleased with all the products. They are exactly the way they have marketed on their website. I'm really grateful that Priyanka and her team  promptly took charge to speed up the delivery process from their end so that the order arrives on time for my party. We received so many compliments for the lights and the personalized ornaments were love by all. I would definitely suggest to consider sending longer strings for the ornaments. Overall, I would definitely recommend shopping from The Sparkle Story. ✨

featured_reviews.name: amit vyas
featured_reviews.review_text: I am amazed to see the quality and detailing of product I ordered. I took a chance on the Sparkle Story as I found them via google. The kind of detailing they did was unparalleled. although the product delivery was late and so got anxious as why an economy business taking too long and dialled them and then I go to know that the customisation takes time and layering after that also takes time. They assured me that once the product is ready, the communication will come to me. I was surprised with their commitment and after sales communication. I will 100% recommend every one The Sparkle Story for best customised gifts for any occasion. Cheers !!

featured_reviews.name: Venkat
featured_reviews.review_text: Wow Nice Product. I didn't expectt his good quality product I receice. (Temperature Tumbler.)My son take this product to school with cold ice cube. It last long from morning to evening. This insulated tumbler can be used to store both hot and cold water, coffee etc. The best part is, As soon as we place order. They take complete responsibility till it get delivered.

featured_reviews.name: Aman Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: The quality of the product is very average and I wouldn't recommend. Their return policy is very unusual which states that if the product breaks within 48 hours of buying then only they will replace it. I ordered the coffee maker and the shaker's plastic stirrer broke as it was made of cheap quality.

featured_reviews.name: Neety Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: The quality and print on the cup are excellent! I gifted it to my husband, and he was so happy with it. The keychain also looks amazing. I’m definitely going to buy more items from here as gifts because the quality is just superb.

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Javery
featured_reviews.review_text:
Have purchased products from them on multiple occasions. They never cease to disappoint.
The products have always been exactly as they show in the description on their website. Their delivery is very quick, and customer support, in case you need some help with something (never needed it for any product or complaint, just delivery info and other stuff), they are just superb and understanding. I was late to order a product once and needed it urgently, 3-4, days before actual delivery date, but on request, they did it for me. Right a day before the birthday. Truly amazing service and equally amazing products. I wish they grow into a really big brand someday and expand their catalogue even more.

So far I've gotten a pouch, notebook, a couple of phone wallets, and a bottle. Gonna purchase more soon. As much as they are good products for gifting, I love to use them myself as well.

Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.review_text: This morning we placed an order with Emotions The Florist for a flower bouquet to be delivered at my cousin's wedding venue [Raghavendra Mutt -Mulund West] at 10am.
